captains_plate_number.name: captains_plate_number
captains_plate_number.value: "captains"."captains"."vehicle" NOT IN ('motorbike', 'car') OR "captains"."captains"."plate_number" IS NOT NULL

captains_suspension.name: captains_suspension
captains_suspension.value:
("captains"."captains"."status" = 'suspended') = ("captains"."captains"."suspension_reason" IS NOT NULL)
          AND ("captains"."captains"."suspended_until" IS NULL OR "captains"."captains"."status" = 'suspended')

online_periods_end.name: online_periods_end
online_periods_end.value:
("captains"."online_periods"."ended_at" IS NULL) = ("captains"."online_periods"."end_reason" IS NULL)
          AND ("captains"."online_periods"."ended_at" IS NULL OR "captains"."online_periods"."ended_at" >= "captains"."online_periods"."started_at")

offers_pay.name: offers_pay
offers_pay.value: ("dispatch"."offers"."pay" IS NULL) = ("dispatch"."offers"."pay_currency" IS NULL) AND "dispatch"."offers"."pay" >= 0 AND "dispatch"."offers"."pickup_metres" >= 0

admin_accounts_has_sign_in_name.name: admin_accounts_has_sign_in_name
admin_accounts_has_sign_in_name.value: "identity"."admin_accounts"."email" IS NOT NULL OR "identity"."admin_accounts"."phone_hash" IS NOT NULL

admin_accounts_active_is_set_up.name: admin_accounts_active_is_set_up
admin_accounts_active_is_set_up.value: "identity"."admin_accounts"."status" <> 'active' OR ("identity"."admin_accounts"."password_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "identity"."admin_accounts"."totp_secret_encrypted" IS NOT NULL)

admin_accounts_totp_reset_has_password.name: admin_accounts_totp_reset_has_password
admin_accounts_totp_reset_has_password.value: "identity"."admin_accounts"."status" <> 'totp_reset' OR ("identity"."admin_accounts"."password_hash" IS NOT NULL AND "identity"."admin_accounts"."totp_secret_encrypted" IS NULL)

journals_reason_required.name: journals_reason_required
journals_reason_required.value: ("ledger"."journals"."type" NOT IN ('custody.adjustment', 'earn.bonus', 'earn.adjustment', 'merchant.adjustment') AND "ledger"."journals"."reverses_journal_id" IS NULL) OR coalesce(btrim("ledger"."journals"."reason"), '') <> ''

categories_window.name: categories_window
categories_window.value: ("merchants"."categories"."window_starts_at" IS NULL) = ("merchants"."categories"."window_ends_at" IS NULL) AND "merchants"."categories"."window_starts_at" BETWEEN 0 AND 1439 AND "merchants"."categories"."window_ends_at" BETWEEN 0 AND 1440

order_events_status_values.name: order_events_status_values
order_events_status_values.value: ("ordering"."order_events"."from_status" IS NULL OR "ordering"."order_events"."from_status" IN ('placed', 'accepted', 'ready', 'picked_up', 'arrived', 'delivered', 'rejected', 'cancelled', 'failed')) AND "ordering"."order_events"."to_status" IN ('placed', 'accepted', 'ready', 'picked_up', 'arrived', 'delivered', 'rejected', 'cancelled', 'failed')

orders_cancellation.name: orders_cancellation
orders_cancellation.value: ("ordering"."orders"."status" = 'cancelled') = ("ordering"."orders"."cancelled_at" IS NOT NULL AND "ordering"."orders"."cancel_reason" IS NOT NULL AND "ordering"."orders"."food_prepared" IS NOT NULL)

orders_captain.name: orders_captain
orders_captain.value: ("ordering"."orders"."captain_id" IS NULL) = ("ordering"."orders"."assigned_at" IS NULL) AND ("ordering"."orders"."captain_id" IS NOT NULL) = ("ordering"."orders"."captain_track" IS NOT NULL AND "ordering"."orders"."captain_track" NOT IN ('searching', 'offered')) AND ("ordering"."orders"."search_started_at" IS NULL) = ("ordering"."orders"."search_alert_at" IS NULL) AND ("ordering"."orders"."captain_track" <> 'searching' OR "ordering"."orders"."search_started_at" IS NOT NULL)

orders_acceptance.name: orders_acceptance
orders_acceptance.value: ("ordering"."orders"."accepted_at" IS NULL) = ("ordering"."orders"."prep_min" IS NULL) AND ("ordering"."orders"."accepted_at" IS NULL) = ("ordering"."orders"."promised_at" IS NULL) AND ("ordering"."orders"."accepted_at" IS NULL) = ("ordering"."orders"."search_start_at" IS NULL) AND ("ordering"."orders"."accepted_at" IS NULL) = ("ordering"."orders"."prep_late_alert_at" IS NULL) AND "ordering"."orders"."prep_min" > 0

orders_accepted_states.name: orders_accepted_states
orders_accepted_states.value: "ordering"."orders"."status" NOT IN ('accepted', 'ready', 'picked_up', 'arrived', 'delivered', 'failed') OR "ordering"."orders"."accepted_at" IS NOT NULL

orders_trip.name: orders_trip
orders_trip.value: ("ordering"."orders"."trip_seconds" IS NULL) = ("ordering"."orders"."trip_metres" IS NULL) AND "ordering"."orders"."trip_seconds" >= 0 AND "ordering"."orders"."trip_metres" >= 0

orders_recipient.name: orders_recipient
orders_recipient.value: "ordering"."orders"."contact_phone_encrypted" IS NULL OR "ordering"."orders"."recipient_name" IS NOT NULL
